title: Evidence-Limited Misbehavior Detection for Connected-Vehicle Telemetry Using Causal Trajectory Features and Sender-Cluster Evaluation
observation_unit: de-duplicated BSM receive event with a causal trajectory window
causal_jitter_definition: causal_jitter_s[i] = |dt[i] - mean(dt[j] for j in 1..i-1)|, where dt[j] is the positive inter-arrival time (receive_time_ns difference / 1e9) of the same sender within the current official split; the running mean is cumulative since the last history reset (a gap > max_gap_seconds) and the feature is masked until one prior interval exists
local_density_definition: number of distinct senders, including the focal sender itself, whose latest position observed within the trailing local_window_seconds lies within local_radius_meters of the focal position (so the minimum valid value is 1)

preprocessing.missing_values: validity masks retained; missing values set to normalized zero
preprocessing.split_policy: official train/validation/test paths; no random test subsampling
preprocessing.receiver_copy_policy: same sender/messageID/sendTime receiver copies collapsed by parser; earliest receive_time_ns retained

model_inputs.isolation_forest: normalized current-step features and validity masks
model_inputs.one_class_svm: normalized current-step features and validity masks; seeded sample of at most 10,000 non-malicious training records
model_inputs.tabular_transformer: L = 10 sequence, causal attention, validity masks
model_inputs.flattened_window_models: logistic regression, random forest, histogram gradient boosting, XGBoost when installed, and the supervised MLP use the flattened L = 10 window of normalized features and validity masks

protocol.seed_variability: mean and sample standard deviation (ddof = 1) across seeds
protocol.threshold_selection: maximum F1 on the validation split, per model and seed
protocol.far_operating_points: test_roc_tpr_at_far: highest test TPR with test FPR at or below the budget (descriptive, uses test scores only to read the curve); validation_calibrated_recall_at_far: threshold set so that validation non-malicious alert rate is at or below the budget, then applied to test, with the realized test FAR reported alongside
protocol.neural_checkpoint_selection: best validation AUROC, early stopping patience 2

sender_cluster_bootstrap.method: paired nonparametric bootstrap resampling composite (corridor_id, source_id) test clusters with replacement; percentile 95% intervals
sender_cluster_bootstrap.skip_rule: replicate skipped when it lacks either class for any model

uncertainty.note: Seed variability reflects model fitting randomness; bootstrap intervals reflect resampling of composite test sender clusters for one training seed. They answer different questions and are not combined.

dataReplay.protocol: pooled official-split models; threshold and FAR budget re-selected on the same attack category's validation records; test restricted to that category

dosAttack.protocol: pooled official-split models; threshold and FAR budget re-selected on the same attack category's validation records; test restricted to that category

dataReplay->dosAttack.protocol: fit and threshold on official dataReplay train/validation; test on official dosAttack test; normalization from dataReplay benign training records
